summary: Fidelity test-adversary PR #343 is ready for independent consumption. Stacked on primary #335 exact head, it adds a source-only regression proving the new reentry fence remains per-entity: an outer transition callback may synchronously step and commit a different entity, while an outer callback failure rolls back only the outer manager transition and preserves the independently committed inner transition/accounting. This closes a non-duplicate regression seam because #335 already tests same-entity recursive step/unregister rejection and cross-entity registration, but not nested cross-entity step. Exact-head canonical CI run 31478090143 is GREEN on 13ae5f8d575a534191067d8b12c6d6e13f08918c. The separate global pr-ownership validation-fence recovery remains outside this lane and is not bypassed. No Studio evidence is claimed.
